  • Collaborate with fellow Guardian PMs covering detection efficacy, red teaming, user experience, policy, and platform so coverage, detection, and enforcement advance together

  • Feed new agentic coverage into detector requirements as agent traffic patterns, payload sizes, and tool contexts evolve

  • Ensure newly covered agent types are represented in red teaming targets and test datasets

  • Enable managed service and threat hunting teams to operationalize agentic telemetry

Leadership & Execution

  • Lead agentic security conversations with customers, prospects, analysts, and executive audiences

  • Translate a fast-moving landscape into crisp requirements, prioritized backlogs, and shippable increments

  • Support Sales and Sales Engineering with enablement, coverage positioning, and competitive differentiation

  • Make hard prioritization calls across breadth of coverage, depth of understanding, and speed of delivery

What You'll Need:

  • 5+ years of product management experience in cybersecurity, AI/ML, or emerging technology domains

  • Strong working knowledge of AI agents, agent frameworks, MCP, and LLM tooling — including how enterprises actually deploy them

  • Technical depth to reason about how agents execute, what artifacts they leave behind, and how they can be observed and controlled

  • Experience owning a defined area within an existing, shipping enterprise product alongside other product managers

  • Track record of operating in markets where the technology landscape changes mid-quarter

  • Experience with inventory, policy, or enforcement surfaces in an enterprise security product

  • Proven ability to partner with engineering teams on complex, novel technical problems

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to influence across functions and levels

  • Proven experience utilizing AI technologies to enhance decision-making, streamline workflows and processes, improve efficiency and drive business outcomes.

Bonus Points:

  • Hands-on use of coding agents, agentic IDEs, or agent orchestration frameworks

  • Familiarity with MCP, A2A, agent identity, and emerging agentic protocols

  • Understanding of LLM security challenges, prompt injection, and AI-specific attack vectors

  • Background in endpoint security, application control, or software supply chain security

  • Experience with policy engine design or large-scale real-time evaluation systems

  • Familiarity with AI governance, responsible AI, or model risk management frameworks

  • Build production-grade SOAR connectors that integrate security platforms (SIEM, EDR, ticketing, IAM) with Falcon Fusion at scale, and contribute to the core platform services that power connector execution, authentication, and orchestration.

  •  Mentor junior and mid-level engineers on distributed systems design, authentication protocols, and production operations best practices

  • You'll own connectors end-to-end—from API research through deployment and production support—while improving the platform capabilities (auth systems, testing frameworks, deployment pipelines) that all connectors depend on

  • Deep expertise in building distributed systems, microservices, REST APIs with a track record of making architectural decisions at scale

  • Hands-on experience in large-scale (distributed) system architecture, high scalability and availability, and optimization

  • Strong debugging skills

  • Proven experience utilizing AI technologies to enhance decision-making, streamline workflows and processes, improve efficiency and drive business outcomes.

  • Demonstrated track record of operational excellence when operating services that span many components across several geographical regions

  • Strong communication skills; working collaboratively and confidently with internal stakeholders

Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.


About the Role:
CrowdStrike is seeking an Enterprise Renewal Sales Specialist to join our Global Renewals Management Function within our GTM organization. As a key sales specialist function, the Enterprise Renewal Sales Specialist is critical to CrowdStrike’s ability to achieve sustainable retention of key accounts, protect annual recurring revenue (ARR), and drive operational discipline in the field for renewal management. This critical teammate will be responsible for retaining and growing CRWD’s renewals by driving customer centric renewal strategy and execution.

What You’ll Do:

  • Protect and Grow Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) by supporting the Strategic and

  • Enterprise Field Sales team in securing renewal contracts in advance of expiration

  • Collaborate with the Strategic and Enterprise Field Sales team on renewal strategy and drive commercial Renewal/Flex alignment

  • Support the execution of an expansion strategy around the renewal (Flex, Reflex, Upsell)

  • Drive smooth renewal execution and close process (negotiate commercial terms, price uplift capture, conversion of a Renewal to Flex)

  • Proactively review, prepare and present renewal sales offers to enterprise renewal seller 90-120 days in advance of contract expiration

  • Ownership of contract processes and Flex activations

  • Research customer license purchase and utilization and make recommendations on renewal proposal

  • Structure renewal scenarios including conversion to our Flex GTM offering, consolidations, and module upgrades

  • Serve as a subject matter expert on subscription management and Renewals for our enterprise customers

  • Flag any risk early on in out quarter renewals in your territory and drive accurate renewals forecast

  • Collaborate with Field sales and Customer Value Architects on any accounts at risk and risk mitigation strategies

  • Be a trusted resource for sales on the enterprise renewal sales process and sales business policies

What You’ll Need:

  • Relevant industry experience: High Tech, SaaS, Cybersecurity preferre

  • Experience with Annual Recurring Revenue business model

  • 5 years of experience in Enterprise Renewals, Deal Support, Contract Management or Customer Success

  • Previous experience managing SaaS Subscription renewals process

  • Experience and proficiency with MS Excel

  • Prior experience using Salesforce.com and/or Salesforce CPQ

  • Ability to successfully balance a wide variety of daily tasks and adjust priorities on the fly in a fast-paced environment over multiple engagements

  • Tech savvy & excited to work in a fast-paced environment

  • Exceptional communication skills and strong business partnership with sale

  • Ability to work independently or in a team environment

  • Extreme attention to detail and highly organized

  • Proven experience utilizing AI technologies to enhance decision-making, streamline workflows and processes, improve efficiency and drive business outcomes.

CrowdStrike is looking for individuals across the industry to add their passion and experience in helping customers realize better security outcomes with log management and advanced data analytics.

As a Consultant on the Platform Professional Services team focusing on Falcon Next-Gen SIEM, you’ll spearhead key efforts and become a trusted advisor to customers by answering technical questions, demonstrating Next-Gen SIEM capabilities, and laying out a technical vision of a Next-Gen SIEM roadmap for customers to follow. Working alongside other Falcon engineers and other cross functional teams, you’ll be a critical part of operationalizing Next-Gen SIEM within customer environments. You’ll work with the customer as they discover what Falcon NGSIEM can do for them, help expand their use cases, and provide feedback timely to Crowdstrike Product Management teams. Simultaneously you’ll develop internal relationships to partner with key stakeholders to influence product enhancements that will meet customer needs.

The position is remote-friendly within the United States with the opportunity for limited travel onsite with customers.

What You'll Do:


  • Work independently providing best-in-class delivery and integration services to a wide range of organizations and verticals
  • Act a trusted advisor to help lead customers to mature outcomes using next generation SIEM, log management, AI assisted investigations and SOAR features and functionality
  • Provide knowledge transfer of Falcon Next-Gen and other relevant Falcon modules to our customers

  • Experience translating your knowledge of customer requirements and experiences into feedback for internal product and engineering teams.

  • Proven experience utilizing AI technologies to enhance decision-making, streamline workflows and processes, improve efficiency and drive business outcomes.

  • Recent (last 3 years) industry certifications with SANS, ISC2, Amazon, Microsoft, Google and other organizations within the Information Security domain.
  • Long term (6 months min) recent experience within a SOC performing analysis and triage of security incidents using a SIEM, Log Management and/or SOAR platform.

About the Role:

The Platform Associate Resident Consultant is an embedded technical advisor who partners closely with strategic customers to maximize the value of their CrowdStrike Falcon investment. This role combines specialized expertise with technical consulting to drive successful CrowdStrike Falcon adoption, optimization, and ongoing operational excellence. The associate resident consultant will have familiarity of all Falcon modules and deep knowledge in a few areas, such as Endpoint, Identity, or Cloud, and is responsible for the planning, deployment, implementation, and operational support of the customer’s Falcon environment.


What You'll Do:

Customer Partnership & Strategy

  • Serve as the primary technical advisor for assigned strategic customer accounts
  • Develop and maintain trusted advisor relationships with customer security teams and leadership
  • Understand customer security operations workflows, use cases, and business objectives
  • Mentor customer teams on Falcon best practices and threat hunting techniques

Technical Implementation & Optimization

  • Providing technical implementation, configuration, and troubleshooting assistance with the deployment of the CrowdStrike Falcon platform and associated applications
  • Assisting customer with operationalizing all modules of the Falcon platform
  • Troubleshoot customer issues across small to large enterprises
  • Utilize and engineer native and 3rd party software deployment technologies
  • Develop scripting and application solutions using Falcon APIs
  • Customer project planning and status
  • Work closely and collaboratively with customer information technology teams
  • Leverage CrowdStrike applications (Exposure Management, for example) provide support to customers in vulnerability and asset management
  • Assist customers with the integration of CrowdStrike into existing tools
  • Guide customer leads with incident management functions 
  • Work closely and collaboratively with Professional Services team to develop customer facing collateral

What You'll Need:

Technical Skills

  • Bachelor’s degree, in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity or a related field, and/or equivalent military or work experience
  • 2+ years of experience with relevant security applications, which could include endpoint, identity, cloud, SIEM, etc.
  • Basic understanding of software deployment technologies
  • Knowledgeable on Windows, Mac, and Linux platforms
  • Experience in computer and network systems security
  • Solid analytical/problem solving skills with capability to identify solutions to unusual and complex problems
  • Proven experience utilizing AI technologies to enhance decision-making, streamline workflows and processes, improve efficiency and drive business outcomes.

Consulting Skills

  • Exceptional communication skills with ability to explain technical concepts to varied audiences
  • Strong presentation and training delivery capabilities
  • Self-motivated with excellent time management and prioritization skills
  • Customer-focused mindset with commitment to driving customer success
  • Ability to work independently in a remote/embedded environment
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical thinking abilities
  • Proactive and thorough ability to manage work and prioritize customer projects
  • High level of motivation; self-starter; results driven
  • Ability to travel up to 20% of the time 

Bonus Points:

  • Endpoint Security: Falcon platform (preferred), AV, and EDR solutions
  • Software Deployment: SCCM, Group Policy, McAfee EPO, IBM BigFix, Puppet, Chef, Citrix, PDQ, PsExec
  • Development: PowerShell, Python, Bash, Batch
  • Technologies: Experience with Host based firewall, File Integrity Management, Data Protection, Vulnerability Management, Attack Surface Management, IT Automation
  • Database: SIEM, MSSQL, Splunk, LogScale
  • Identity: Identity, Active Directory, Azure-AD, SSO
  • Cloud: AWS, Azure, and GCP
  • Currently have or can obtain necessary security clearances, per customer requirement

As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. About the Role:

The Platform Resident Consultant is an embedded technical advisor who partners closely with strategic customers to maximize the value of their CrowdStrike Falcon investment. This role combines specialized expertise with technical consulting to drive successful CrowdStrike Falcon adoption, optimization, and ongoing operational excellence. The resident consultant will have familiarity of all Falcon modules and deep knowledge in a few areas, such as Endpoint, Identity, or Cloud, and is responsible for the planning, deployment, implementation, and operational support of the customer’s Falcon environment.


What You'll Do:

Customer Partnership & Strategy

  • Serve as the primary technical advisor for assigned strategic customer accounts
  • Develop and maintain trusted advisor relationships with customer security teams and leadership
  • Understand customer security operations workflows, use cases, and business objectives
  • Mentor customer teams on Falcon best practices and threat hunting techniques

Technical Implementation & Optimization

  • Providing technical implementation, configuration, and troubleshooting assistance with the deployment of the CrowdStrike Falcon platform and associated applications
  • Assisting customer with operationalizing all modules of the Falcon platform
  • Troubleshoot customer issues across small to large enterprises
  • Utilize and engineer native and 3rd party software deployment technologies
  • Develop scripting and application solutions using Falcon APIs
  • Customer project planning and status
  • Work closely and collaboratively with customer information technology teams
  • Leverage CrowdStrike applications (Exposure Management, for example) provide support to customers in vulnerability and asset management
  • Assist customers with the integration of CrowdStrike into existing tools
  • Guide customer leads with incident management functions 
  • Work closely and collaboratively with Professional Services team to develop customer facing collateral

What You'll Need:

Technical Skills

  • Bachelor’s degree, in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity or a related field, and/or equivalent military or work experience
  • 5+ years of experience with relevant security applications, which could include endpoint, identity, cloud, SIEM, etc.
  • 3+ years of client-facing consulting experience
  • Basic understanding of software deployment technologies
  • Knowledgeable on Windows, Mac, and Linux platforms
  • Experience in computer and network systems security
  • Solid analytical/problem solving skills with capability to identify solutions to unusual and complex problems
  • Proven experience utilizing AI technologies to enhance decision-making, streamline workflows and processes, improve efficiency and drive business outcomes.

Consulting Skills

  • Exceptional communication skills with ability to explain technical concepts to varied audiences
  • Strong presentation and training delivery capabilities
  • Self-motivated with excellent time management and prioritization skills
  • Customer-focused mindset with commitment to driving customer success
  • Ability to work independently in a remote/embedded environment
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical thinking abilities
  • High level of motivation; self-starter; results driven
  • Proactive and thorough ability to manage work and prioritize customer projects
  • Ability to travel up to 20% of the time 

Bonus Points:

  • Endpoint Security: Falcon platform (preferred), AV, and EDR solutions
  • Software Deployment: SCCM, Group Policy, McAfee EPO, IBM BigFix, Puppet, Chef, Citrix, PDQ, PsExec
  • Development: PowerShell, Python, Bash, Batch
  • Technologies: Experience with Host based firewall, File Integrity Management, Data Protection, Vulnerability Management, Attack Surface Management, IT Automation
  • Database: SIEM, MSSQL, Splunk, LogScale
  • Identity: Identity, Active Directory, Azure-AD, SSO
  • Cloud: AWS, Azure, and GCP
  • Currently have or can obtain necessary security clearances, per customer requirement
